description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, targeting Herd Baloth
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ghave's ability, targeting Berta.
Resolve the first Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the second Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
